text:
maya: quick heads-up — finished heteromix bakeoff on stella-7b variants (FP8 / INT8 / AWQ combos). putting notes here before handing to infra for a multi-environment roll. tl;dr: some AWQ mixes look promising for latency/cost but we see tail-case hallucination deltas on factual QA sets.

liam: high level numbers: hosted p99 token-latency down ~18% vs baseline fp16 for AWQ-int4 mix, cost per token -34%. INT8-only is more stable on QA but less latency gain. FP8 gives best quality but slower. sample sizes: 2.5k queries across open-domain QA + internal support logs.

anita: what does "hallucination delta" mean here? any example? we need exact regression repros for eval gating.

liam: yea — e.g. prompt: "When was company X founded?" baseline fp16 -> correct 2009. AWQ-mix returned 2011 in 4/2500 cases, mostly long-context Qs with date parsing. attached repro snippets in the eval harness: `tests/factual/date_parsing/*.yaml`

maya: thanks. we need a safety gate: if factual-accuracy drop >0.8% vs baseline on the golden-set, block canary. canary can run for non-factual routes only if pass.

raj: for rollout planning — prefer corridor approach across hosted/dedicated/private: start hosted canary 1% -> 5% -> 20% (24h each), dedicated reserved pool 0% initially (shadow traffic), private (customer opt-in) with explicit opt-in flag. fallback rules: route to fp16 baseline if golden-set accuracy regresses or if p95 latency > SLO * 1.5.

maya: sounds good. we also need a sample-mining hook to capture mispredictions and user-visible regressions and push to the eval dashboard. storage retention 30d for sample triage.

liam: proposed automated thresholds:
```
// rollout thresholds
golden_accuracy_drop_threshold: 0.008  // 0.8%
regression_alert_window: 60m
canary_stability_target: p95 latency < 1.25 * baseline_p95
fallback_tps_spike: >2x baseline
```

anita: add quality buckets: factual, toxicity, formatting. each with a golden set and smoke probes. if any bucket fails, automatic rollback to last stable variant.

raj: routing note: allow policy override per-tenant for private deploys. some regulated customers must stay on fp16. implement a per-tenant allowed-quant-levels list.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started: heteromix-awq-int4-stella7b -> hosted-corridor: 1% traffic. rollout id: r-2245609876-01

maya: keep error budget watchers on. disabled auto-rollforward for first 48h.

liam: we'll run a focused probing set (n=1200) split 60/40 short vs long-context; long-context currently where deltas appear. also adding temperature/beam sensitivity checks.

anita: please capture model-output diffs for the failing golden examples — we need to label and surface to reps for manual review. create a short triage playbook.

maya: playbook notes: 1) if golden factual drop > 0.8% -> immediate pause + notify eng-sre + create regression ticket. 2) if user-visible error rate (support) increases > 15% w/in 24h -> rollback. 3) if p95 latency regresses > 25% -> scale dedicated pool or fallback.

raj: ops implementation detail: use existing traffic-split API with `variant_policy: corridor` and `fallback_chain: [awq-mix, int8-fallback, fp16]`. Also include `health_probe: golden-set-check` every 5m.

liam: small config snippet for the eval harness: 
```
eval: {
  probes: ["golden_factual_v2","smoke_toxicity","formatting_spotcheck"],
  sample_retention_days: 30,
  alert_thresholds: { "golden_factual_v2": 0.008 }
}
```

anita: can we gate private rollouts with an explicit signed-off field from security/compliance? for any private customer, require `signed_off_by` in the rollout metadata.

maya: yes — add `signed_off_by` required for private=true. infra: please add showstopper label if missing.

deploy-bot: canary progress update (T+3h): error rate normal, golden_factual delta = 0.4% (within threshold), p95 latency -15% vs baseline. continuing.

liam: next steps from ML side: 1) run a diversity reweight on training prompts used for AWQ hooks 2) run a quick quant-safety sweep with more seeds 3) push failing examples to annotation queue. estimate: 36h.

anita: i'll own annotation queue and triage. please tag me on the regression ticket.

maya: assign owners: liam -> bakeoff metrics + quick fixes; raj -> rollout policy + infra hooks; anita -> triage + golden set maintenance; maya -> final release signoff.

raj: noted. planning to add a per-tenant emergency-fallback label we can flip from the console in <30s.

maya: perfect. thanks team — will sync tomorrow 11am to review T+24h metrics. :thumbsup:

liam: thanks, will post the detailed CSVs and diff snapshots in the shared drive (link incoming).

deploy-bot: canary progress update (T+24h): golden_factual delta = 0.6% (stable), support-visible regressions = +2% (within noise), p95 latency -14%. advancing to 5% traffic.

maya: logging this thread for the rollout runbook. if anything critical surfaces ping #incidents immediately.
